description: Search the whole web and get ranked results: title, URL, snippet, site and publish date, plus top news when relevant. Filter by recency (day/week/month/year), country and language. Independent index (Brave Search). Pair with page_to_markdown to read a result. Costs $0.005 per call.

country.description: Two-letter country for local results, e.g. "US", "DE".

freshness.description: Only pages from the last day, week, month or year.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "x402 payment protocol" or "site:github.com mcp server".

name: web_search
title: Web search
